context: One docs-focused PR. For each ADR: append dated addendum sections rather than rewriting decision history (ADRs pin decisions); the receipts design note is living documentation and is edited in place. The only code change permitted here is the A2 summary-key rename if that option is chosen (zero production consumers; update the pinned unit tests in the same commit).
description:
From the 2026-07-31 adversarial review doc-vs-code sweep. Fix after (and consistent with) tuning-corroboration-gate-failed-and-dropped-20260801, which changes the trust rule these docs describe.

A1 (Required, doc contradicts code): docs/development/tuning-introspection-receipts.md:89-105 says DuckDB's CTAS 'drops that index... a sorting-only run honestly stays applied_unverified' and calls the fix out of scope - but benchbox/platforms/duckdb.py:961-1020 now re-creates idx_<table>_sort post-CTAS (_recreate_sort_index_after_ctas) and records it precisely so the run can verify. Stale at birth (both shipped in 30dcc8a).

A2 (vocabulary): _VERIFIABLE_VERDICTS includes UNVERIFIABLE (introspection.py:64), so summary.verifiable_total (introspection.py:190) counts no-rule/blocked statements the doc defines as NOT verifiable (receipts doc:27-29,52). Gate outcome unaffected. Decide: rename the summary key (it has zero production consumers - verified in the review) or redefine it in the doc; either way make code and doc agree.

A4: ADR-001:120-124 says the ledger is populated only via the recording proxy; the direct ClickHouse record-at-execute (workload.py:76) and the deferred _applied_layout_operations fold (adapter.py:1181-1206 - reconstructed position, not observed) are undocumented there.

A5: receipts doc:44 'order- and case-normal' is ambiguous; comparison is order-sensitive for every kind (introspection.py:441-444). Say 'in order' on all four rows.

A6: transient/maintenance prefix sets are wider than the doc table - RESET/USE transient, VACUUM/ANALYZE/COMPACT maintenance (introspection.py:264-265) - i.e. statements the doc routes to the blocking 'anything else' row are silently non-blocking. Document (or narrow) deliberately.

A7: receipts doc:129 stale '~line 984' wiring pointer (now adapter.py:1017-1033/1097).

A3: ADR-001:130-142 sample statement record shows 'mechanism': null fields the hashed to_dict() omits (applied_ledger.py:138-150) - the documented shape is not the hashed shape.

A9: ADR-003 context is stale with no addendum: OLAP pack condition inverted (clickhouse/tuning.py:91 applies when tuning_enabled), generators now render in execution (workload.py per ADR-3 single renderer), generate_tuning_clause dead-code note obsolete.

R6: document the Snowflake key-vs-physical-clustering semantics asymmetry if not already landed by snowflake-clustering-precheck-and-schema-filter-20260801.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not expand the transient/maintenance prefix sets while documenting them
anti_patterns.instead: document the current sets; any widening needs its own reviewed item
anti_patterns.why: widening non-blocking classes silently weakens the upgrade gate

anti_patterns.dont: Do not fix doc drift by weakening claims into vagueness
anti_patterns.instead: state the exact current mechanism with file anchors
anti_patterns.why: vague docs are how three of these drifts survived review

anti_patterns.dont: Do not rewrite ADR decision sections in place
anti_patterns.instead: append dated addenda marking what has since landed or inverted
anti_patterns.why: ADRs are a decision log; history rewriting destroys their evidentiary value

preserves.behavior: ADR decision history stays intact - addenda only, no rewriting of recorded decisions.
Docs describe the POST-gate-change trust rule (failed/dropped blocking) - coordinate with the gate item to avoid documenting the old rule.
If verifiable_total is renamed, receipt summary changes are additive/renamed-with-tests only; the upgrade gate logic is untouched.
